Title: Logged-in user adds a product and places an order
Test Data: Samsung galaxy s6; order form: name, country, city, card 4111111111111111, month, year
Steps:
1. Log in with valid credentials
2. Open Samsung galaxy s6, note price
3. Add to cart
4. Open Cart; verify line and total
5. Click 'Place Order'; verify modal total
6. Fill form and click 'Purchase'
7. Verify receipt; click OK
8. Re-open Cart
Expected Result: Receipt 'Thank you for your purchase!' with numeric Id, Amount = cart total, Name = entered name, card last 4 digits, today's date; OK returns to home; cart is now empty.

Title: Guest orders several products
Steps:
1. Add two products as guest
2. Open Cart
3. Place Order with valid data
Expected Result: Receipt Amount = sum of both prices.

Title: Only mandatory fields filled (Name, Credit card)
Steps:
1. Open Place Order
2. Fill only Name and Credit card
3. Click 'Purchase'
Expected Result: Order succeeds; receipt shows the entered name.

Title: Name empty
Steps:
1. Open Place Order
2. Fill everything except Name
3. Click 'Purchase'
Expected Result: Alert 'Please fill out Name and Creditcard.'; no receipt; cart unchanged.

Title: Credit card empty
Steps:
1. Open Place Order
2. Fill everything except Credit card
3. Click 'Purchase'
Expected Result: Alert 'Please fill out Name and Creditcard.'; no receipt; cart unchanged.

Title: All fields empty
Steps:
1. Open Place Order
2. Click 'Purchase' without filling anything
Expected Result: Validation alert; no receipt; cart unchanged.

Title: Name is whitespace only
Steps:
1. Open Place Order
2. Enter spaces as Name, valid card
3. Click 'Purchase'
Expected Result: Order is rejected like an empty name.

Title: Validation message text
Expected Result: Alert text is exactly 'Please fill out Name and Creditcard.'

Title: Closing the order form keeps the cart
Steps:
1. Open Place Order
2. Fill the form
3. Click 'Close'
4. Reload Cart
Expected Result: No order placed; cart still has the item.

Title: Unicode / special characters in name
Steps: 1. Place an order with the special-character name
Expected Result: Receipt shows the name exactly as typed; no HTML is rendered/executed.

Title: Receipt date shows the current month
Steps:
1. Place an order
2. Read 'Date' on the receipt

Title: Order with an empty cart
Steps:
1. Open empty Cart
2. Click 'Place Order'
3. Fill valid data, click 'Purchase'

Title: Credit card must be numeric
Steps: 1. Place an order with a non-numeric card

Title: Receipt masks the card number
Steps:
1. Place an order
2. Inspect 'Card Number' on the receipt
Expected Result: Only the last 4 digits are shown (e.g. **** 1111).

Title: Invalid month / year values
Steps:
1. Enter invalid month and a past year
2. Click 'Purchase'

Title: Very long input values
Steps:
1. Fill the form with very long values
2. Click 'Purchase'
Expected Result: Handled gracefully: validation or truncation, receipt layout not broken.
